title: Turkish Smoky Onion Meatballs
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish inspired by Turkish cuisine, featuring smoky meatballs served with caramelized onions.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, smoky paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Add caramelized onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix until evenly distributed.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into meatballs, about 1 1/2 inches (3.8 cm) in diameter.
Place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch (2.5 cm) of space between each meatball.
Bake in the preheated oven for 18-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the meatballs are baking, heat the crushed tomatoes in a saucepan over medium heat.
Once the meatballs are done, transfer them to the saucepan with the tomatoes and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
